name: token-price-sdk
description: Universal, isomorphic CEX & DEX token price SDK for Node.js and Browser — multi-exchange aggregation, monthly kline binary archives, token support checks, and dual-driver storage (SQLite / IndexedDB).

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const path of ['dist','coverage']) { try { require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch {} }"
